# Brancher

> Brancher is an AI-powered mentoring platform that connects organizations with structured mentorship programs to drive employee engagement, retention, and leadership development.

Brancher provides enterprise mentoring software designed for organizations across government, universities, enterprises, and communities. The platform uses AI-driven mentor matching, personality assessments, and multiple mentoring formats (1-1, peer, reverse, and group) to support talent development and organizational culture.

## Key Topics

- Mentoring Software
- AI Mentor Matching

## Platform & Product

- [Mentoring Software Designed for Business Growth](https://brancher.com.au/mentoring-software): Brancher mentoring software with Core and Enterprise pricing plans
- [Mentoring Platform Features – Brancher Product Overview](https://brancher.com.au/product): Brancher platform features including matching, peer, reverse, and group mentoring
- [How Brancher Works – Mentoring Made Simple](https://brancher.com.au/how-it-works): Overview of Brancher's mentoring platform features and implementation
- [Strengths & Values Analyzer](https://brancher.com.au/strengths-values-analyzer): Personality assessment tool for mentor-mentee matching and rapport building
- [Product - Ava AI](https://brancher.com.au/product-ava-ai): Ava AI coach add-on powered by Claude for participant support and guidance

## Industry Solutions

- [Solutions - Organisations and Enterprise](https://brancher.com.au/organisations-and-enterprise): Enterprise mentoring platform with GDPR compliance and Fortune 500 focus
- [Solutions - Government](https://brancher.com.au/government): Government sector mentoring solution with data security and enterprise reporting
- [Solutions - Universities](https://brancher.com.au/universities): University mentoring for student, alumni, and staff development
- [Solutions - Associations and Communities](https://brancher.com.au/associations-and-communities): AI-powered mentor matching for associations, communities, and networking

## Business Outcomes

- [Solutions - Increase Employee Engagement](https://brancher.com.au/increase-employee-engagement-0): Mentoring programs for employee engagement via 1-1, group, and peer mentoring
- [Solutions - Reduce Employee Turnover](https://brancher.com.au/reduce-employee-turnover): Mentoring-driven employee retention and turnover reduction solution
- [Solutions - Provide Leadership Development](https://brancher.com.au/provide-leadership-development): Leadership development through succession planning and mentoring programs
- [Solutions - Develop High Potentials](https://brancher.com.au/develop-high-potentials): Talent management and high-potential employee development via mentorship

## Mentoring Applications

- [Solutions - Boost Diversity, Equality & Inclusion](https://brancher.com.au/boost-diversity-equality-and-inclusion): DEI mentoring including Women in Leadership and ERG group programs
